name: describe_individual
description: Describe an individual in one answer: its kind and the kinds that kind specialises, the individuals holding it (which often say what it is, such as 'held as root of a Cup'), and each of its fields with its meaning and value, held individuals described in turn down to the depth asked. Values marked '(default)' are the field's declared default rather than a measurement. Individuals beyond the depth appear as 'see <handle>'; describe them in turn only if they matter.

depth.description: How many levels of held individuals to describe.
